text: The fault is in the cart service in the default namespace: the CART_ADDR environment variable is missing from its deployment configuration [E1]. This causes the cart service to fail connecting to Redis, as shown by the log error [S1]. The issue affects the cart service's ability to connect to Redis. M2 proposes patching the cart deployment to add the CART_ADDR environment variable with value redis-cart:6379 [E1]. This proposed fix is checked by the safety gate (M3) before it runs. The reads confirmed this diagnosis.
